svg.title: Asset allocation wireframe
svg.text: PLANS / PLAN FOR RETIREMENT / SETTINGS / ALLOCATION
Plan mix, account overrides, and a glide path.
Dated points interpolate; an account override does not change the plan curve.
An override applies to that account only.
Total is 105%. A mix must total exactly 100%
Save stays disabled until the server accepts the mix.
The plan holds a stock and bond mix. Each dated point changes it over time.
The glide path interpolates between dated points; the client renders the returned curve.
Account overrides are per account and are listed with the mix applied.
Validation rejects any mix that does not total 100%, with a stable code and the offending field.
